title: Travis commands reference missing test and Windows solution paths
summary: CI invokes indigo_test/test_suite.sh, which is absent, and changes into indigo_windows before invoking a solution that now lives at the repository root. Those commands fail even when compilation otherwise succeeds. Next: coordinator assigns CI command repair to current portable test and solution entry points; validate path resolution without installing dependencies or probing hosted CI.
